## LankaServe v3.0.0

This major release rebrands the mobile app as **LankaServe**, keeps citizens signed in between app launches, and makes the AI verification pipeline much stricter about which documents belong to which workflow stage. It also adds a service picker and search across the admin portal, and brings the web and mobile codebases back to a clean lint and analyzer state.

### Highlights

- **New mobile app identity** - the app is now called **LankaServe** on Android, iOS, Windows, Linux and web, with a new adaptive launcher icon.
- **Persistent sign-in** - mobile sessions are stored in the platform's encrypted storage (Android Keystore / iOS Keychain), so closing the app no longer signs the user out. The session is cleared on sign-out or when the token expires.
- **Stage-scoped document verification** - uploads from earlier stages no longer leak into later stages, and AI agents audit only the documents required for the current stage.
- **Service procedure picker** - a searchable picker modal and tab-level search filters across the service catalog, eligibility rules and service configuration screens.

### AI agents and verification

- Agent 2 (Eligibility & Documents) and Agent 4 (Validation & Safety) prompts refined: hardcoded document biases removed, unrelated filenames are checked for semantic relevance, and audits are scoped strictly to the stage's required documents.
- Agent 4 statutory advisor enhanced, with common service categories decoupled from department-specific ones.
- Intake agent grounded to the service catalog's documents.
- Dynamic service knowledge mapping and category normalization for the RAG knowledge base.
- Improved document categorization, stage fees and cognitive-safety guardrails in the officer verification workspace.

### Backend

- Fixed DUP-002: a `PendingReview` submission is only treated as a duplicate while its verification task is still Pending, Revised or Revision Requested. Approved or rejected applications can be submitted again.
- Stage document isolation fixed in `ApplicationDraftingService` and `VerificationController`.
- Payment and application submission flow updates, plus a data repair service for existing records.

### Web portal

- Service procedure picker modal and per-tab search filters for documents, fees and policies.
- Improved service configuration UI and template builder flow.
- Finance dashboard: fixed duplicate notes textarea, caret jumping and stuck rejection validation.
- Officer pending reviews: live metrics now calculate correctly.
- Admin pages (eligibility rules, eligibility simulator, service configuration, department management, department dashboard) no longer call React hooks conditionally after their access checks, which could break rendering when access changed.
- Resolved all ESLint errors (React hooks rules, effects that set state, `any` types, fast-refresh exports).

### Mobile app

- Department services are populated dynamically in the payments tab.
- Fixed layout overflows on the verification detail screen.
- Token recovery and fallback in the verification API service.
- Application form flow improvements.
- Delivery option selection migrated to the new `RadioGroup` API (clean `flutter analyze`).

### Documentation

- Project documentation, API reference and Azure hosting guide updated.
- New ADRs: 0015 (Groq LLM over deterministic agents) and 0016 (backend container on Azure App Service, web on Vercel).

### Upgrade notes

- The mobile app's display name changes from "Gov Navigator" to "LankaServe". Users will see the new name and icon after updating.
- Mobile now depends on `flutter_secure_storage`; run `flutter pub get` after pulling.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/Goverment-Service/Government_Service_Navigator/compare/v2.0.0...v3.0.0
